title: Persist immutable Photo admission-revision lineage

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Admission lineage tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/inventory/test_admission_lineage.py

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done.

evidence_required: .memory-bank/domains/photo-admission.md#admission-time-serving-revision-lineage RED: an admitted Photo has no immutable persisted revision selecting its original pending state, so a later revision state cannot be distinguished without inference; GREEN: one empty-table linear migration adds non-null Photo admission_pipeline_revision_id with RESTRICT revision reference, atomic admission writes it from the same IngestTarget as the matching pending state, and a non-empty Photo table aborts before schema/data mutation; decisive comparison: empty-path upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade and one admission pair retain exact identity while the non-empty path is unchanged; artifact: isolated migration/admission transcript and database projections.
purpose: Create the one immutable persisted admission-revision fact required to select each accepted Photo's sole SLO state after additional revision states exist.
success_outcome: An accepted Photo atomically persists its IngestTarget revision and matching pending state; the additive pre-production migration refuses non-empty Photo data rather than guessing or mutating lineage.
anti_goals: Do not add a revision history, registry, jobs table, monitoring store, serving-switch behavior or second processing lifecycle.
Do not backfill, delete, repoint or infer an existing Photo/state relation from current serving selection, timestamps, status, attempt count or revision order.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
SLO aggregation or staff API behavior owned by TASK-028 and later consumers
stop_conditions: A non-empty Photo table must be preserved rather than explicitly reset before the pre-production migration.
The durable fact would require a second state/history table, current-serving inference or an ownership-changing data contract.

constraints: Extend the current linear Alembic head at execution; do not assert a mutable future exact head.
Use one non-null immutable Photo admission_pipeline_revision_id copied from the existing IngestTarget and matching PhotoPipelineState key in the same admission transaction.
Inventory owns the admission transaction and invokes processing only through the existing typed initial-pending boundary; neither transport nor processing writes Photo identity directly.
Before its first schema mutation, require face_moment.photos to be empty; do not synthesize or mutate lineage for any existing Photo.
Use unique disposable PostgreSQL state, a known initial condition, safe rerun and task-owned cleanup.
invariants: One accepted Photo retains exactly one immutable admission revision and one matching initial pending state.
Later serving switches or additional revision states never rewrite, replace or multiply the persisted admission lineage.
The one application schema, Base/MetaData and linear migration stream remain unchanged; no database cascade crosses ownership boundaries.
verification_targets: Empty-table migration proof covers direct down_revision, upgrade, downgrade and re-upgrade with the exact non-null RESTRICT shape; non-empty Photo fixture proves unchanged abort before mutation.
Atomic admission integration proof compares the Photo admission revision with the initial pending composite key, then proves rollback publishes neither relation.
